plan.notes: Official UMPI Academic Program of Business Administration 'Finish in Four' academic map for Business Administration B.A., Management & Leadership concentration (department page, undated; live as of 2026-10-10). The map is the department's published recommended semester sequence; the department notes it is a scheduling aid and students should consult the catalog for official degree requirements. HONEST CREDIT NOTE: the map states 'Total Minimum Credits Required for Degree: 120 credits' but the Third Year Spring GEC/GE slot is published as 3-4 credits, making the transcribed minimum 119. Choice slots are recorded at minimum credits per convention; the 4-credit variant of that GEC/GE slot (or one additional credit) is required to reach the 120-credit degree minimum. Generic GEC/GEL (General Education/Elective Course) slots are transcribed with distinct codes per coordinator convention. The course marked * (BUS/COM 210) meets General Education Curriculum requirements.
